# dsh-basemind-plugin
English | 繁體中文
Workspace-aware BaseMind bridge for DeepSeek Harness. Install the bundle and every session gets Base
Mind's code-intelligence tools for the repository that session is working in — no MCP row to configu
re, no agent preset change.
New to BaseMind? Start with the BaseMind introduction.
## 1. What it is
This is a DSH bundle. It starts BaseMind's own MCP server (`basemind serve`) for the repository the
session is working in, registers the tools BaseMind advertises, and keeps them pointed at that works
pace as the session moves. A `cd` inside a session makes the next call use the new repository withou
t restarting anything. It has no UI page and does not modify any agent preset.
| | Manual `basemind` MCP row | This bundle |
| Workspace root | static `cwd` in the row config | resolved per call from the session's working dir

ectory |
| Tool set | fixed at connect time for that one root | discovered from `tools/list` |
| Row
s to configure | one MCP row (plus a manager entry) | none — the bundle inserts its own plugin row |
| Several repositories | one more row each | one relay per root, automatically |

## 3. Compatibility
| Component | Requirement |
| DeepSeek Harness | `>= 0.2.1-rc.3 < 0.3.0-0`, declared in `engines.dsh` and enforced by DSH at ins

tall and startup. This version is verified on `0.2.1-rc.5`. |
| Node.js | `>= 24.20.0` (declared in

`engines` and pinned with Volta). The plugin is plain ESM with no dependencies. |
| BaseMind | Any v
ersion. The plugin does not pin or gate BaseMind: the tools it exposes are exactly what the running
`basemind serve` advertises through `tools/list`. This version is verified on BaseMind `0.31.1`. |
## 4. Install
### 4.1 Install BaseMind
Install the `basemind` program first, following the BaseMind introduction, and check the environment
asemind` program first, following the BaseMind introduction, and check the environment DSH will use:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
If DSH cannot find `basemind` on `PATH`, point the plugin at the executable with an absolute `BASEMI
ND_BIN` (or its `command` option).
### 4.2 Install the bundle
- **DSH Desktop:** open the plugin manager (the **Plugins** page), install `dsh-basemind-plugin`, an

d enable it.
- **CLI-managed profile:** install it with the profile you boot:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Installations are per profile. If the runtime asks for a restart or a disable/enable toggle to load
the new bundle, do that.
### 4.3 Verify
In a session opened on a project, call `mcp__basemind__admin` with `{ "mode": "repo" }`. It returns
the workspace root and HEAD of that session's repository. Under the default `serverName`, nine tools
are registered: `admin`, `agents`, `code`, `git`, `graph`, `memory`, `shell`, `web`, `workspace`.
### 4.4 Update and remove
- **Update:** Plugins page → Update, or `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-basemind-plugin@late

st`.
- **Remove:** disable or uninstall the bundle in the plugin manager, or `dsh plugin --profile <
profile> remove dsh-basemind-plugin`.

### Tools
| Tool | Covers |

| `mcp__basemind__admin` | status, repo info, rescan, cache statistics, gc, telemetry |
| `mcp__base

mind__agents` | multi-agent communication |
| `mcp__basemind__code` | outline, symbols, grep, files,
find, definition, references, callers, implementations, dependents, expand, semantic search, chunk

|
| `mcp__basemind__git` | status, history, blame, diff |
| `mcp__basemind__graph` | calls, neighbou

rs, paths, subgraphs, communities, map, export |
| `mcp__basemind__memory` | memory put/recall, docu

ment search |
| `mcp__basemind__shell` | long-lived shell sessions |
| `mcp__basemind__web` | scrape

, crawl, list |
| `mcp__basemind__workspace` | workspaces, worktrees, branches, claims |
The modes are read from the running BaseMind, so a newer version may expose more. BaseMind's MCP res
ources (`basemind://status`, `basemind://repo/map`) are exposed as resource server `basemind`, so `l
ist_mcp_resources` and `read_mcp_resource` work against them.
